summary: Removes CloudSyncData/CloudSyncCallback from DBAdapter, ActiveCloudSyncData from MetaInfoManager, and ActiveSyncMetaData/IsNeedActiveSyncData from OnLineTask. The online_task.cpp DoSyncInfo no longer calls ActiveSyncMetaData on SyncMetaInfoFromDB failure. This means when meta info DB sync fails, there is no longer any fallback active sync mechanism. The removal is intentional (the feature was added in unit 24 and removed here), but the fallback gap remains: if SyncMetaInfoFromDB fails, meta data will simply be unavailable with no recovery path.
